findings.title: Uncapped liability for breach of platform focus commitment
findings.deviation: Section 7.1 excludes breach of Section 3.3 (Platform focus) from the USD 250,000 aggregate liability cap, leaving liability for breach of Section 3.3 uncapped.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited monetary liability in the event of a breach of the platform focus restriction.
findings.quote: Neither party is liable for indirect damages. Each party's liability is capped at USD 250,000, except for breach of confidentiality or Section 3.3.
findings.counterPosition: Remove the carve-out for Section 3.3 so that liability for breach of Section 3.3 is capped under the general liability cap.

findings.title: Exclusivity restriction regarding specified partner competitors in Territory
findings.deviation: Section 3.3 restricts AtliQ and its Affiliates from forming new reseller or implementation partnerships with three named competitors within the specified Territory during the Term.
findings.impact: AtliQ cannot enter into new reseller or implementation partnerships with the three specified platforms in the covered regions during the term.
findings.quote: Platform focus. During the Term, Partner shall not, and shall procure that its Affiliates shall not, enter into any new reseller or implementation partnership with the providers of Zephyr Lakehouse, Polarbase Warehouse or StratoGrid Analytics Cloud in the Territory.
findings.counterPosition: Delete Section 3.3, or confirm against AtliQ's internal register that AtliQ has no existing or planned partnerships with the named entities in those territories.

fine.note: Mutual confidentiality obligations with a 3-year post-termination term match playbook standards.
Mutual termination for convenience on 90 days' notice complies with playbook standards.
